summary: Coordinated multi-stage insider threat and data exfiltration detected. An unauthorized login from external IP 198.51.100.72 compromised account dchen, harvested proprietary patent archives, escalated privileges via sudo to svc_admin, traversed laterally to critical server SRV-CORE-02, and exfiltrated sensitive vault keys to an unapproved USB mass storage device.
risk_rationale: 5 linked attack stages (+100); data exfiltration (+20); privilege escalation (+15); lateral movement across hosts (+15); capped at 95

stages.explanation: Adversary gained initial access via unusual external login from IP 198.51.100.72 using account dchen onto workstation WS-DEV-01.
Adversary performed collection by accessing confidential archive confidential_patent_core.tar on WS-DEV-01, a sensitive asset never previously accessed by this user.
Adversary escalated privileges on host WS-DEV-01 by exploiting sudo configurations to assume privileged identity svc_admin.
Adversary moved laterally from workstation WS-DEV-01 to core server SRV-CORE-02 using compromised credentials of svc_admin.
Adversary executed physical/endpoint exfiltration by copying customer vault secrets to unauthorized removable medium USB-SECURE-VAULT on SRV-CORE-02.

recommendations.why: Block external source IP to neutralize ingress connection and prevent follow-up command-and-control access.
Invalidate active session tokens and Kerberos tickets for compromised user account dchen.
Quarantine workstation WS-DEV-01 to sever network connectivity and prevent further lateral expansion.
Force immediate password and credential rotation for privileged service account svc_admin.
